learning_outcomes: Define and calculate average speed using speed = distance / time
Sketch and interpret distance-time graphs: gradient = speed
Define velocity as speed in a given direction
Define acceleration as change in velocity divided by time; calculate using a = (v – u) / t
Sketch and interpret speed-time graphs: gradient = acceleration, area under graph = distance
Apply the equations of uniformly accelerated motion to solve problems (Supplement)
State that the acceleration of free fall near the Earth's surface is approximately 10 m/s²
Describe terminal velocity and explain the forces acting on a falling object
